title: The local rings of a scheme and of its base change to the completion have isomorphic completions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a scheme over a local ring with finitely generated maximal ideal, the local ring of a point of the base change to the completion and the local ring of its image have isomorphic completions (statement lines 2965-2972). The proof (proof lines 2973-2994) reduces to an affine situation and compares the quotients by the powers of the relevant prime ideals. H2: a complete short computation.
